description: A gray plastic tub with ice cubes sits on the table, with a small yellow cup to the left and a purple scoop to the right. The right hand picks up the purple scoop and slides it into the tub to gather ice, while the left hand steadies the tub; then the left hand lifts and holds the yellow cup as the right hand tips the scoop over it, dumping the ice into the cup before pulling the scoop away.
